description: How to show structure in a plan file, PR description or doc: a hand-placed SVG diagram or chart that takes its colours from one shared stylesheet and follows the reader's light or dark mode, or a text view in a code block (file tree, call chain, component tree, table columns, settings, routes, a type's shape). Use whenever a diagram, chart or text view goes into a Markdown file a person reads, including writing a plan's or doc's data model, file layout, settings, endpoints or types. Not for backoffice screen mockups or screenshots.
